reviews.name: Priya Malik
reviews.title: Worked brilliantly with WP All Import; the support is excellent.
reviews.comment: I was concerned about using a free plugin for a large project for a client; however, I need not have been, as the plugin performed excellently. I had to import over 4,000 products from a CSV using WP All Import, but I didn't want to import all the images. I wanted to point each product to an external online folder for its image. This plugin has allowed me to keep the website size down to around 150 MB, rather than the 4 GB+ it would have been with all the images. This makes it SO MUCH easier to administer the website going forward. The process worked perfectly, without any issues or any confusing options. Moreover, I had a question about the product images not displaying in the cart. I emailed Marcel, and he replied within an hour and resolved my issue. I cannot rate this plugin or its author highly enough. I always try to support authors who do excellent work, so I have confirmed that I will be purchasing the premium version in order to support his efforts. Thanks!

reviews.name: Ethan Holloway
reviews.title: The plugin is perfect, the support is world-class
reviews.comment: The plugin is great (paid version). All the customizability you need, and very simple and easy to use. There are always going to be conflicts with special themes or other plugins, and these were quickly hashed out and easily fixed with the plugin's great support, thanks to Marcel. All my boring image thumbnails are now autoplay MP4 videos, and this is a game changer for my business as a VFX studio. If I could give this plugin a better rating, I would.

reviews.name: Freya Lindgren
reviews.title: Exceptional product and support!
reviews.comment: I recently had the pleasure of configuring the FIFU plugin for my website, and I am beyond impressed with both the product and the support provided by the FIFU team. In my extensive experience of building over 2,500 websites, I can confidently say that the commitment and professionalism demonstrated by the FIFU team are unparalleled. During a challenging debugging period, their support went above and beyond, providing solutions when no one else could. This level of dedication truly sets them apart in the industry. One standout feature is the timely and efficient response to support tickets. Unlike many other plugins, the FIFU team addresses concerns promptly, showcasing their commitment to customer satisfaction. This responsiveness is a breath of fresh air in an industry where delayed or non-existent responses are unfortunately common. The FIFU plugin's lightweight design ensures a fast-loading website, exceeding expectations even under stress tests with 500 products. As I scale up to over 12,000 products, I'm confident in its ability to consistently deliver outstanding results. FIFU's efficiency has significantly contributed to the success of my website. The FIFU team has set a new standard in a field where support is often lacking. They are a reliable, customer-centric, and highly skilled development team. My experience with their plugin has been smooth and enjoyable. I'm excited to use it with my new API to load over 200,000 product variation images, and I anticipate great success. I highly recommend the Featured Image from URL plugin!

reviews.name: Martina Moretti
reviews.title: Amazing plugin and support!
reviews.comment: This plugin is such a fantastic solution for websites with many images that would otherwise overload the server. I'm so happy that I found it! It works flawlessly, and the issues I had when trying to connect to files on Dropbox were fixed within hours. Marcel answers support requests almost instantly (even on weekends!) and is extremely fast and helpful, beyond what would be expected. Thank you, Marcel, your generosity is appreciated! I am also impressed with the willingness of the developers to make it easy for the user to succeed in having a fast-loading website at a low cost. They provide a CDN solution for free, and they are not trying to push you to the cloud hosting alternative they also provide, which is actually very reasonable and will be my choice at the right time. I have bought the Pro plugin and warmly recommend it to anyone, especially if you have many images.

reviews.name: Milena Kuznetsov
reviews.title: Great plugin and outstanding support
reviews.comment: My website has some unusual features, which initially caused some issues with FIFU. Marcel was very understanding and worked together with me for several hours to identify the cause. Then he was able to quickly adapt FIFU to resolve the issue. FIFU is now working perfectly on my website, and all external links are saved as the featured image. Great plugin and outstanding support!

reviews.name: Matteo Ricci
reviews.title: The best solution out there for external images
reviews.comment: My site needed the ability to add external images for posts in some cases. So I started to search online for possible solutions. I found some ideas in forums on how you can theoretically do this, but I am not a very experienced programmer and have limited coding skills, so I searched for plugins that could do it. I found 'Featured Image from URL', and it was a really great solution. The only issue was that the pictures added via the FIFU plugin looked out of place dimension-wise. That is because all WP themes create all the necessary thumbnail sizes when an image is added to the WP database, whereas in this case it was just a link to an external source. I started to look for other solutions, but I stopped soon, because the few that were out there were so much weaker. Some were not supported, some did not work, and some did not have even half the features FIFU has. So I went back to FIFU and found that FIFU Premium has a cropping feature. I contacted the author, and he answered very fast that the cropping feature would solve the issue. After acquiring the FIFU Premium version, I received it very soon, installed it, and at first had problems configuring everything properly. So the author helped me once more: he looked at my case and at my theme, created a test environment for further testing, and prepared precise instructions on what I needed to do to achieve the intended result. He even added a requested feature without hesitating. I really recommend the premium version to everybody. Not only because it is the only plugin that delivers what it promises (in regard to adding featured images from URLs), but also because of the great support. The support was fast, precise and very friendly. I am grateful to the author for the fantastic plugin.

reviews.name: Ananya Adebayo
reviews.title: Amazing plugin and customer service!
reviews.comment: I had been looking for this functionality for a while, specifically for Flickr content. I installed the free version and upgraded after only one day, I was so pleased. The plugin performed as stated out of the box, but I had a small issue with my own theme (not guaranteed by the author), and he STILL went above and beyond to work with me and resolve the conflict. I am blown away by how wonderful this plugin and the support are! In just a few days he pinned down my issue, modified the plugin, and went to my site to review and confirm that everything had been resolved. I highly recommend this plugin, as well as anything written by this developer. The best WordPress premium purchase I have ever made!

reviews.name: Inès Garnier
reviews.title: Excellent plugin and stellar support!
reviews.comment: 99% of my site's content is submitted by front-end users. When users reference images and video from external sites, posts are often left without any featured image. This plugin is a lifesaver. It takes the first external image in the content and sets it as the featured image automatically if none is set on submit! Now I don't have an ugly default image all over the category list page. Thank you! Not only is the plugin exactly what I was looking for, but Marcel is incredible. The best support I have received in years of web development. I wish I could give 10 stars. Thank you, Marcel!

reviews.name: Charlotte Reid
reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.comment: Perfect! Works beautifully! I blog about multiple topics and keep the posts on different sites, but I'm not using multisite; each site is independent. I'm using another plugin (Syndication) to syndicate blog posts between these multiple standalone WordPress sites. That requires me to use yet another plugin to automatically move all my images out to Amazon S3. Needless to say, my setup isn't very straightforward. This plugin was the final (PERFECT!) piece of the puzzle I needed to get my personal blog network set up and looking good. Now I can publish posts on my hidden blog that get syndicated out to my niche blogs, and they all have nice featured images served up by Amazon S3.

reviews.name: Jonas Brandt
reviews.title: A real game changer and lifesaver!
reviews.comment: This plugin saves me so much time when I want to comment on an external article or news report. It's really easy to use, and my posts all have a consistent look in the archives and search results, whether the featured image is local or comes from FIFU! Thank you!

reviews.name: Santiago Ribeiro
reviews.title: Absolutely essential plugin for any WordPress site!
reviews.comment: FIFU has been a total game changer for my website! I've tried a lot of image management plugins, but none come close to the flexibility and performance FIFU offers. Being able to set featured images directly from URLs saves so much storage space and time — especially for content-heavy sites. The plugin is lightweight, fast, and integrates perfectly with themes and other plugins. I love how intuitive the interface is — you can bulk edit, automate image imports, and even control lazy loading with ease. It's obvious that the developer really understands what WordPress users need. The support team is also fantastic — quick to respond, friendly, and super helpful whenever I've had a question. Updates come regularly, and each one adds something genuinely useful rather than just cosmetic changes. If you manage a WordPress site and care about performance, SEO, and workflow efficiency, FIFU is an absolute must-have. It's one of those plugins you install once and wonder how you ever worked without it. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Lorenzo Bianchi
reviews.title: Great plugin, we're thinking of moving to Pro
reviews.comment: A great plugin for those of us who also work with XML feed publishing, since it avoids overloading our server's connections. As we have many articles, we plan to purchase the Pro version in 2026. We want to take advantage of the CDN. Thanks for the developer's support: fast and attentive answers. Good support is a sign of seriousness. I wanted to write this review in Italian, because in 2025 it is very easy to translate.

reviews.name: Sven Schreiber
reviews.title: Exactly what I needed!
reviews.comment: I'm using the premium version on my book logging/review site to grab book cover images from the Amazon page URLs I was already entering to create affiliate purchase links. It was a bit bumpy at first, but the plugin author was extremely attentive and helped me over the course of several days to get things working exactly as I'd hoped! Highly recommended if you need an easy and quick way to grab an image from an external URL.

reviews.name: Raphaël Perrin
reviews.title: Long-awaited answer
reviews.comment: I've been waiting for years for a plugin that pulls and displays a video thumbnail as the featured image for my video-oriented posts. (My theme does not support a video post format for the blog.) FIFU grabs the thumbnail of the YouTube video and sets it automatically as the featured image. Perfect. We've worked with the developers to iron out how posts that are not video posts but contain a video are handled. They've been responsive and addressed our issues right away. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Amira Adebayo
reviews.title: Amazing plugin & brilliant support
reviews.comment: This is an amazing plugin with A LOT of features that can make your website look great! It can be very useful for bloggers, businesses and any other website owner… but features wouldn't be very useful if you ran into a problem. I had a theme and plugin conflict, and the customer service was AMAZING! They solved the problem very quickly and gave me an update at each step. I HIGHLY recommend the plugin with its wonderful customer support! Thank you!

reviews.name: Margaux Rousseau
reviews.title: Brilliant plugin
reviews.comment: What a wonderful find! The plugin helped solve the Vimeo thumbnail issue that afflicted our augmented reality filter site overnight in September, when Vimeo deprecated their historic CDN URLs without warning and obliterated our entire site, even though we are a paying Vimeo customer. The plugin was adapted to solve this issue, and the developer tirelessly worked to isolate the unusual bugs on my production site that prevented the plugin from working as expected. You do have to be wary of the multitude of settings the plugin has, and perhaps some of the routines/combinations for tasks could be clearer, but overall I'm very pleased with the plugin and greatly appreciate the support effort.

reviews.name: Greta Vos
reviews.title: Great plugin, and the support service is of paramount quality!
reviews.comment: I have been using this plugin (Premium version) for a long time now, and it has saved me lots of hours, effort and money (hosting, storage, bandwidth and more). Don't think twice; go Premium. It is a great plugin, and the support service is of the highest quality, extremely responsive and helpful. Thank you so much!

reviews.name: Sanne Bakker
reviews.title: Superbly unique
reviews.comment: A great plugin that is unique in what it offers! It works like a charm and connects the images you are hosting on YOUR CDN or cloud account with your WP website. Unlike other plugins that require you to sign up for new CDN accounts, this one works with your existing storage. Great job, Marcel! And superior support too!

reviews.name: Elena Ricci
reviews.title: Great plugin, with amazing support
reviews.comment: FIFU conflicted with another plugin I was using. I sent an email to the author, and he responded within 12 hours and resolved the issue within the next 24! The plugin does exactly what I need it to, without any unnecessary code to slow down page loads, and the author helped customize it for my needs. Definitely 5 out of 5 stars!

reviews.name: Sami Sharma
reviews.title: EXCELLENT plugin and SUPPORT
reviews.comment: I recently had a problem with my FIFU. I messed with it for several days with no luck. I just assumed customer service would not be helpful, because so many are not these days. I was dead wrong. I emailed support, and I got an email back within 20–30 minutes. They were very friendly and helpful. They gave me detailed instructions; I followed them, and my issue was resolved. Customer service here is 5 stars for sure. I cannot say enough good things about them! I am not very techy, so I have much appreciation for them and their help today. My biggest surprise is that someone actually replied and took care of my problem. Highly recommend! I also love the plugin itself, but the support is amazing and outstanding.

reviews.name: Yusuf Abebe
reviews.title: Very useful tool
reviews.comment: If your website is going to have lots of blog posts, pages and products, then storing FEATURED IMAGES in the Media Library can consume lots of space and slow down the website. (Remember, each image is converted to many sizes for thumbnails, etc.) That is THE problem this plugin solves. It works very well. I save images in my Google Photos account and pull them from there as featured images for blog posts. (Storing images elsewhere may be tricky, as that server may have its own clean-up schedule.) Three cheers for Marcel!

reviews.name: Sophie Bennett
reviews.title: Amazing plugin
reviews.comment: It helped me complete a custom WooCommerce project. I get the images from a custom backend and set the external image URL using a cron job.

reviews.name: Andrés Molina
reviews.title: Amazing plugin and support
reviews.comment: It's amazing how much space on your host, and how much time downloading and uploading images, you can save with this plugin. It works fine, and the support is amazing. The developer is also fantastic and answers any support question within a few hours. A great choice.

reviews.name: Hana Kim
reviews.title: Excellent plugin, fantastic support
reviews.comment: The plugin was exactly what I was looking for when I wanted to host my images externally. It worked flawlessly in wp-admin, but I couldn't figure out the WooCommerce API (user error) to create the links. The developer worked with me to figure out how to use the WooCommerce API in order to sync the FIFU links. He provided so much support for me. I highly recommend this plugin for its awesome functionality and exceptional support.

reviews.name: Riccardo Marino
reviews.title: Works perfectly, and great support
reviews.comment: I was looking for a long time for a plugin that could automatically create a featured image based on the first image in my post. This is the only plugin that worked. It can also create featured images from image URLs. It works easily and effortlessly. I initially had a plugin conflict, and the author was very helpful and helped me solve my problem. Very good plugin and support.

reviews.name: Jin Sato
reviews.title: The easiest-to-use URL image plugin, and it keeps improving
reviews.comment: My favorite part of this plugin is that I don't need to do anything redundant when writing a post. It can automatically pick the first URL image as the featured image. Just look at its settings page; it's not a simple and naive one like the others. At first it was problematic with my Newspaper theme, but after I contacted the author, he quickly fixed the issue. A very nice and active developer!

reviews.name: Chloé Lambert
reviews.title: Really great plugin
reviews.comment: A really good plugin. It does what it should and fills a gap in our theme that the theme developers did not want to address. I decided to go for the Pro version and asked the developer for a special feature for my needs. He was ready to integrate it into the Pro version for me. He worked on the plugin until it did what it should with our theme. This is a level of service you get from only a few developers, and Marcel is one of them. We recommend it. It's a pleasure to donate. Thanks a million!

reviews.name: Ella Parker
reviews.title: Superb support, with WP All Import/Export integration
reviews.comment: I purchased the Pro version to utilize some of the import/export functionality. The developer was quick to add an additional feature that allows for directly exporting the featured images in WP All Export (Image URL column) and importing them into the fifu_list_url custom field. Super functionality!

reviews.name: Anton Petrova
reviews.title: Perfect for Open Live Writer!
reviews.comment: There was no way to add a featured image using Open Live Writer (formerly Windows Live Writer) until this brilliant plugin came along! It works perfectly! It grabs the first image in the post (or page) and sets it as the featured image. Another fantastic benefit is the featured image thumbnail in the all posts/pages list; it's so handy to see whether there is one and what it is. Cheers!

reviews.name: Isabela Ribeiro
reviews.title: Great plugin – no more right-sizing and optimizing photos
reviews.comment: I was able to delete about 40 photos from my media library — I just did my posts. I'm speed-conscious, so I always right-size and optimize photos. I now have higher-quality photos on my posts with no impact on my page speed. Don't link to photos on slow sites; they are slow to load.

reviews.name: Diego Salazar
reviews.title: Excellent tool
reviews.comment: It solves one of the biggest difficulties when publishing a post: the associated image. Generating an image for each post can consume more resources than the time it takes to create the content itself. This incredible plugin solves that.

reviews.name: Charlotte Bennett
reviews.title: Amazing, works well and is useful
reviews.comment: The FIFU plugin is a powerful tool designed to optimize image SEO for WordPress websites. It helps speed up page loading time by enabling lazy loading for images, improving website performance. FIFU also allows you to easily add image optimization settings, including WebP support, alt text, and more, which can boost search engine rankings. This plugin is perfect for enhancing the user experience and improving overall site SEO without requiring advanced technical knowledge.

reviews.name: Niklas Bakker
reviews.title: Great plugin for what I needed it for
reviews.comment: I decided to go ahead and rate it. A long time ago I needed to be able to use images saved on my main website as the featured image in some of my blog posts that referenced the content over there. This allows me to do exactly that. Since that's the only feature I really use, that's all I can comment on. Thanks for keeping it updated.

reviews.name: Giulia Conti
reviews.title: Great functionality, great support
reviews.comment: I switched to the premium version of this plugin for the YouTube functionality, and it does exactly what I need it to. The company has also provided amazing support, with almost immediate response times whenever I have a need. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Dev Mensah
reviews.title: Works well. Great support
reviews.comment: Using the Premium version. No problem getting it to work; easy to use. I had a minor issue with the FIFU alt tags not working correctly, but the response from Marcel was first-rate and the issue was quickly resolved.

reviews.name: Margaux Lefèvre
reviews.title: Solid plugin, constantly updated
reviews.comment: We've been using FIFU on several sites for a few years to save on space. It has worked flawlessly and is updated quickly when the external link rules change. The support alone is worth its weight in gold.

reviews.name: Grace Palmer
reviews.title: Great plugin with first-class support
reviews.comment: I purchased the plugin for the ability to play locally hosted MP4 videos as the featured product image. There was a slight issue with the autoplay, which was solved quickly by the first-class support on hand to help. The support for this plugin really is exceptional and worthy of 5 stars. Thank you, FIFU!

reviews.name: Lena Jensen
reviews.title: Absolutely amazing
reviews.comment: FIFU is a real lifesaver, especially if you work with a ton of products and can't host every image locally. It works flawlessly out of the box (with documentation and compatibility with other plugins such as WP All Import), and it's crafted to pure perfection. Also, mad respect for its developer, Marcel: not only did he create a truly unique plugin, but he is also super kind and helpful whenever you need any help!

reviews.name: Francesca Moretti
reviews.title: Amazing support
reviews.comment: I just wanted to drop a few good words about this plugin's support. A month ago I got a new client asking me to fix her website. I found that the original developer who built her site used the plugin 'Featured Image from URL (FIFU)' to pull images from her Google Drive. As you can imagine, this is not a normal way to handle WordPress photos. But I must say that the development team behind this plugin is just amazing. They always responded to my questions in a matter of minutes. After they checked my issue, they found that the original developer hadn't used the plugin as it should be used. They responded quickly to my questions and issued a few updates to the plugin that solved my issues. I'm not a registered user of the plugin, but even so, I got excellent support from the developer.

reviews.name: Oliver Brooks
reviews.title: The BEST of the BEST! Don't settle for less! I am so happy I found FIFU!
reviews.comment: I am SO impressed with FIFU. It doesn't stop at just giving you what you need; it provides you with things you didn't even know you needed at first! There is so much thought and detail put into this awesome app. It's a labor of love, and it shows! And for those who manage bbPress, BuddyPress or BuddyBoss forums, you are in for a treat! YES! I found an app that works perfectly for all three! I am so HAPPY! You can even make a forum look like Reddit! No, I was not asked to write this review, nor was I compensated for it. I am a paying customer and someone who is SO impressed by the amazing support and talent behind this app. Hands down the most decent, knowledgeable and coolest developer EVER! Have you ever come across someone or something that just keeps bettering itself continuously? If yes, then you have found gold right here. If not, then you'll find out what premium really means! With every release, these guys keep raising the bar! No wonder there are over 61,000 installs as I write this. Do the math. Premium is SO worth it! This app is worth every single penny and then some! Thank you, FIFU. You really are a shining star, not just as an app but as a model developer! Cheers!

reviews.name: Aaron Morgan
reviews.title: Works very well + great support
reviews.comment: The plugin works really well and helps offload your server, saving tons of space if you have an image-heavy blog. Also, the author is great at providing support and advice, or even adding a feature if it's something more users can benefit from. Thanks!

reviews.name: Isabela Mendoza
reviews.title: Easy to use and fast support
reviews.comment: I reported a bug, and the plugin owner reacted in a timely manner. This plugin is the way to go for our site, which needs frequent thumbnail changes from a remote server. Great job!

reviews.name: Riccardo Gallo
reviews.title: Excellent plugin and technical support
reviews.comment: This is a wonderful solution for getting my ever-growing media library back under control. Works perfectly. I had a question, and tech support resolved it in a matter of hours. Five stars!

reviews.name: Oliver Hayes
reviews.title: Very useful plugin, superb support!
reviews.comment: Really handy to be able to serve featured images (as well as images in general) from a URL. The plugin works really well; the only minor issue I had was solved by the plugin author in under an hour. Impressed!

reviews.name: Amira Khalil
reviews.title: Best support ever
reviews.comment: The plugin is light, very complete and easy to use. It doesn't slow down the system, and it doesn't offer unwanted functions. Its focus is featured image management, and it solves this with mastery. I have never experienced such fast support and commitment. They are absolutely respectful and professional, and they will go further than they have to with their help and support.

reviews.name: Lily Reid
reviews.title: Useful plugin by a dedicated developer
reviews.comment: I'm using the premium version of this plugin to display a video as my featured image, and I have been very impressed with the responsiveness from Marcel. He released a fix for an issue I ran into within 24 hours of my initial inquiry. I'm happy to support developers with this kind of dedication and professionalism.

reviews.name: Maren Koenig
reviews.title: Featured Image from URL is so handy
reviews.comment: I use this to override the default featured images in my posts without browsing my media gallery. It's a quick one-two for developers who move fast. Support is fast too, and this is important! All is well.

reviews.name: Milena Horák
reviews.title: Great and fast service
reviews.comment: I tried using the basic version of the plugin, and it worked well. But I needed the full functionality of the premium version to be able to customize the images I was bringing in. It did not initially do what I needed it to. The author of the plugin helped me get things working VERY fast. I was very impressed with the service.

reviews.name: Rafael Carvalho
reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.comment: We have been using it for more than 3 years, just to use an external image as the featured image. Today it has more features, some paid and some free, but that doesn't interfere with your posts. And always, always, whenever I have problems, Marcel very politely helps us and solves them. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND IT!

reviews.name: Chloé Renard
reviews.title: Great plugin for external images
reviews.comment: I'm using it to link external images to my site, and it is the only one that works, and it works great. Also, the WP All Import integration is perfect for my WooCommerce site. Many thanks to Marcel for the plugin and the great support.

reviews.name: Hugo Marchand
reviews.title: Great plugin and great support
reviews.comment: This plugin works very well, is easy to use, and solved a very specific problem for me. The author even added a feature that I requested… in just a few days. So, great support as well.

reviews.name: Catalina Duarte
reviews.title: Great product & support
reviews.comment: Marcel put up with my grumbling for a few hours while customizing his plugin to turn off an unneeded feature. This plugin works great for using remote images as WooCommerce product images and galleries. Just make sure your theme is not using custom WooCommerce pages. Thanks again, Marcel.

reviews.name: Dmitri Volkov
reviews.title: Now all in one!
reviews.comment: No need for two separate types of plugin anymore: 1. One that sets any URL image (not only from the media library) as the featured image. 2. One that lets the featured image be viewed in the posts/pages lists on the admin side. Today this one provides both functionalities. Nice work!

reviews.name: Mathias Bakker
reviews.title: Works great!
reviews.comment: I use a lot of free images, and I like to repay the photographers with the credits they deserve. This plugin lets me do that.

reviews.name: Martina Herrera
reviews.title: Fantastic plugin! Great support! Best plugin I've ever installed!
reviews.comment: By far, FIFU is the best plugin I have ever downloaded and installed for my site. It saves me so much time; I've been able to move forward so quickly with a large number of new product additions that used to take forever to add to my store. I will never go back to the 'old way' after using FIFU.

reviews.name: Jin Tanaka
reviews.title: Great plugin and support
reviews.comment: I had a small issue that turned out to be a problem with another plugin. Marcel provided outstanding support and pointed me in the right direction.

reviews.name: Leila Mehta
reviews.title: Very good support and easy to get up and running
reviews.comment: Very good support and easy to get up and running. The plugin works perfectly, the support is super attentive, and they help you with everything. It's worth paying for the license; I have done so, and I am very happy with it!

reviews.name: Théo Renard
reviews.title: I recommend it to everyone
reviews.comment: Marcel responded to my email in less than 30 minutes; I didn't even expect that. The support is really great and the communication is superb. As for the plugin itself, it's just amazing and really worth having (I got the Pro version and am completely happy with the purchase).

reviews.name: Ivana Novák
reviews.title: Best plugin for featured images!
reviews.comment: The best plugin! I've been using it for a long time! It might sound silly, but putting all article images on a CDN, including featured images, saves a lot of hosting disk space. Thank you so much!

reviews.name: Zara Haddad
reviews.title: Very helpful and quick support
reviews.comment: Marcel answered my question within 15 minutes and helped me diagnose the issue. I am very grateful for his quick response and thorough answers. FIFU is an incredibly useful plugin, made even better by its helpful developer.

reviews.name: Mason Barnes
reviews.title: The plugin is very useful and support is very fast
reviews.comment: I had some trouble with the plugin, and the plugin owner answered and supported me right away, helping me solve it in a short time. Great job. Highly recommended for any website owner who wants good thumbnails on their site.

reviews.name: Simone Moretti
reviews.title: Thanks to the developers
reviews.comment: I have used this plugin for a long time. When I ran into trouble, I contacted the developers. The response came faster than I imagined. The problem was resolved, and a newer version was released in a very short time. So, thanks to the developers.

reviews.name: Mei-Ling Chen
reviews.title: Excellent and fast support
reviews.comment: I have always used Featured Image from URL to replace WordPress's built-in featured images. Recently I ran into some small problems and sent a support request by email. Unexpectedly, even though I use the free version, the author still helped solve the problem very quickly and enthusiastically. A great user experience.

reviews.name: Chloe Brooks
reviews.title: Excellent plugin
reviews.comment: This is an excellent plugin. What's more, you get instant help if there is an issue. I had one this morning, for the first time since I started using this plugin. I sent an email to the address provided and got instant help. Problem solved in under 10 minutes. Great!

reviews.name: Emma Fletcher
reviews.title: Very fast support for a great plugin
reviews.comment: It's working very well and saves me a lot of hosting storage. Support is fast too, and this is important! All is well.

reviews.name: Manon Girard
reviews.title: Useful plugin with great support
reviews.comment: I've been using this plugin to load external images for an e-commerce site, and it's so useful. Also, the support from Marcel is great, super fast and precise!

reviews.name: Elena Gallo
reviews.title: Great support and plugin
